summary: Protect origin headers, JSON export formats and read-only mirrored MCP learning boundaries.
reason: Configured headers belong to their original destination; JSON-only exports must not silently reinterpret unsupported formats. Read-only mirrored tools must not write automatic learning journals or derive active flag corrections.
validated_outcome: Controlled foreign redirects drop origin headers, unsupported export formats fail before requests/files, native read-only child context preserves learning state, and writable helpers retain current committed active-WAL recall with correct tool hints.
